transcript: Speaker A: अबे 10 मिनट से खड़ी हूँ, चाय नहीं बन पाई तेरी? [Hey, I've been standing here for 10 minutes, is your tea not ready yet?] Speaker B: Sorry for the delay Ma'am. [Ma'am, it's the era of English. Now look at yourself, I spoke in English so you also spoke in this manner. That's why learning English has become necessary for everyone. That's why I downloaded the PW Talk app. PW Talk app has videos that teach English just like reels. When I get time, instead of wasting time on reels, I watch this. And then to practice, there is also an AI English teacher named Reeba. She talks to you in English, corrects your mistakes. And she is AI, right, so there's no fear of making mistakes in front of her. I've been using this app for a few weeks, and my English is definitely getting better.] Speaker A: वाह भाई, बहुत बढ़िया। क्या नाम बताया ऐप का? [Wow brother, very nice. What did you say the name of the app was?] Speaker B: पीडब्ल्यू टॉक। [PW Talk.] Speaker C: इंग्लिश स्पीकिंग सीखना है तो पीडब्ल्यू टॉक ऐप अभी डाउनलोड करो। [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]

summary: A tea vendor surprises a customer by speaking fluent English, explaining he learned it via the PW Talk app. He highlights the app's reel-like short videos and its AI teacher, Reeba, which helps users practice speaking without judgment. The ad concludes with a call to download the app on Google Play.
